interpretationRules: Replace the wood floor with a large lava lake below the floating track. Omit the carpet, vent, and other household background objects.

Treat the toy car on the course as the spawn marker and orient it along the first driveable segment. A checkered flag marks the finish. If a marker is ambiguous, use the visible course endpoints and document the choice.
Build a race. Keep the reference's colored magnetic tiles, black striped road, ramps, towers, and relative route layout. Add up to two intermediate checkpoints before the finish.
Turn green mat pieces along the course into a non-driveable slime pit with a jump ramp and a viable landing. Ordinary green magnetic tiles remain track pieces.
Place visible dinosaurs as matching reusable prefabs. They can turn and lunge to attack nearby vehicles while their bases stay anchored.

Make only the geometry changes needed for a finishable route. Join unintended gaps, make steep approaches driveable, and verify the race with normal steering and throttle. Register it in levels/official/order.json.

processedImages.notes: The red car on the teal tower marks the start. The orange car is outside the track. The striped descent leads onto the stacked causeway. The green mat becomes the required jump. With no clear checkered flag visible, the lower-left raptor end becomes the marked finish.

The red car marks the launcher start, and the checkered silver transporter marks the finish. The yellow jaws and the upright blue tile form ordered checkpoints. The orange loops frame the stationary lime dinosaur, and five balloons fly over the course.

The red car starts behind the gray gate. The missing road was built through the screw field, volcano jump, white triple gate, drill tank and claw. This reference calls for driving around the curved slime before the checkered finish.

The raised red tile marks the start. The amber pipe takes over steering through its purple exit causeway and hands control back on the black road. The turquoise tile has an open hole to the lava, and both silver overpasses are driven under. The volcano sits beside the pink bend, and the purple ramp crosses the slime to the checkered finish.

Spawn on the fireplace mantel. Ramp to the 150-wide white table for the chicane and slalom with two checkpoints. Chair-top bridge arcs onto the piano octave; each white key flashes its rainbow voice and fades back to white. Goal ring past the last key. Wood floor is lava; carpet, vent, toys and the plastic dinosaur omitted as background objects.

The orange car at the foot of the yellow straight marks the spawn. Race up the straight, through the junction bend and blue slide, jump the slime pit from the green-mat kicker onto the landing, then take the orange loop turn to the finish ring. With no checkered flag visible, the loop-piece exit becomes the marked finish. Wood floor is lava; rug, vent, launcher, cauldrons and pumpkin omitted as background objects.

The green car on the purple ramp marks the spawn. Race under the red arch, over the tan block, jump the green-mat slime pit, then hit the Triple-Loop-style booster to clear the wide middle gap. Thread the orange/blue junction past the lime dinosaur to the standing red brick finish. Wood floor is lava; rug, pegboard, launcher toys and bags omitted as background objects.

Hand-sketch coursemap. Spawn top-left down the west straight past the 2x chomp book (half on the road) into the southwest corner. Yellow trap path: harmless bumps feed the EVIL tube, which auto-drives its fixed guided descent at 21 u/s (about 3x cruise) over a short tiled causeway into a spiked lava dead end (do not enter). Correct pink path east across the bottom through the screw field and over the lava pit jump. Transit tube auto-drives around the southeast bend. North up the east straight between the teeth and the lava spill, climb to the shooter tube, which carries the car across the 55-unit lava-pit road gap (read into as across: a literal into landing is unsurvivable, and the pink correct-path line continues past the tube to the finish). Timed volcano jump, then the checkered finish.

Overhead toy-track photo on wood floor. Red car spawns at the bottom of the long black dashed road and drives it north under the blue magnetic-tile gate. Red ember-wyvern lunges from its perch east of the road past the gate. Narrow colored-tile path (yellow, orange, teal, orange) then the orange/teal box den east of the path (inner teal car omitted as background). Yellow pipe towers with an overhead span squeeze the road before the finish. Letter-block wall two high across the road is the final obstacle: foam-light loose blocks scatter on contact and chip 10 percent of a part when one falls onto the truck. Ad-libbed extension past the first wall: tile chicane, green raptor, second pipe span, scattered blocks, and a 3-high final wall with a runout guard. A bumper-arena siding (spur plus floor plus six AI cars) branches west off the mid road as an optional detour; checkpoints skip it.
Snowy U: book dodge west, letter-block wall with burning coals, giant raptor east, 3x snowman burst, checkered finish

Hand-sketch loop. Start top-right down the east straight, chomp book on the south bend, hands and squish cup up the west alley, boost-pad jump over the lava gap beside the erupting volcano, finish gate on the north straight.

Round white table crowded with Hot Wheels track toys. No start or finish markers, so built as an arena: 8 collectible rings scattered around the table, stunt loops, dino launcher raptor, potion test tube, cacti desert tile, burner cauldron, jaws, ghosts, carousel, lamps and destructibles. Toy cars, pegboard and basket omitted as background objects.

Floor photo with inline instructions. Start at the letter blocks (breakable wall), potion tube on the right, kicker jump over the cacti patch, skim the shark pool at speed, drive the dino-mouth tunnel with red walls, white teeth and green roof, ramp to the gray platform finish. Sharks are a new lethal comic hazard that wrecks slow swimmers; cacti a new solid decor kind. Rug, vent, pumpkin, launcher toys and balls omitted as background objects.
